DDInter1900.mechanism: Concurrent use of multiple prostaglandin analogs, as well as more frequent administration of a prostaglandin analog than recommended, may reduce the intraocular pressure (IOP) lowering effects of these agents.

DDInter208.mechanism: Concurrent use of multiple prostaglandin analogs, as well as more frequent administration of a prostaglandin analog than recommended, may reduce the intraocular pressure (IOP) lowering effects of these agents.

DDInter209.mechanism: In patients using bimatoprost or other prostaglandin analogs for the treatment of intraocular hypertension, the concomitant use of bimatoprost 0.03% ophthalmic solution to treat hypotrichosis of the eyelashes may interfere with the desired reduction in intraocular pressure (IOP).
